Use stack version for this chat
It reads original LINE notifications, reorganizes them into easier-to-follow notifications, and posts new stack version notifications.
Open Android notification access settings and allow LINE Notify+ to read LINE notifications.
Return to settings and turn on the switch so LINE messages can be stacked.
Thread mode is better for continuous conversations. Apple grouping mode preserves each message as an individual notification.
After notifications arrive, chats appear in the management page and can be turned on or off individually.
One chat is shown as one notification, with messages stacked like chat history. Best for groups, communities, and busy conversations.
Every message is its own notification, and Android groups them by chat. Best when you want each message to keep its own notification state.
Why does it need notification access?
The app can only rebuild LINE notifications after NotificationListenerService reads their content.
Will the app upload my messages?
No. The app has no INTERNET permission, analytics, backend, or self-update feature.
What does replacing original notifications mean?
When enabled, the original LINE notification is hidden and only the rebuilt LINE Notify+ notification remains.
What if quick replies do not send?
This is still being investigated during closed testing. Keep the notification and report the phone model, Android version, and LINE version.
